verdict.rationale: The Washington Secretary of State is an online government filing and records service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, API, or any agent-connectable interface. It covers only web filing pages, downloadable forms, live chat, in-person service, and a tax portal that serves a JavaScript application shell.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
